Operator Lin has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for inflicting well-timed Arts casualties on a large scale.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Caster Operator during field operations to exercise Phalanx Caster responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.

description.en: The night is giving way, and the streetlamps are going out one by one. The only light left hangs in front of a food cart on the side of the street, swaying and flickering, steam drifting up beneath it. The vendor sits by his wok, face hidden behind the steam. He sees a customer in the distance, and stands to raise himself up a little. 'You haven't been by in forever, Miss.' 'I'm finally freed up.' 'You're a busy person. I see you passing through this street every day, but you never sit yourself down here.' 'One bowl of cart noodles. Oil noodles, curry base, two finballs to top. 'Got it.' The customer picks herself a spot close to the stovetop, and leisurely seats herself. The cart vendor turns around, stooped over like a fin stranded on land. He ladles out soup to boil the noodles, and chops up the meat, movements fluid and natural. 'You're still open so late. Looks like business is good.' 'All by grace of the Rat King... well, used to be. Now it's by yours, Miss. Back when I was apprenticing, no one would dare open at this hour.' 'Is your medicine still enough?' 'I've got ways to buy it, and I've never dared stop. I'll get sick if I'm not careful, and that'll be a hassle for you.' 'No, look after yourself. If you do fall sick, that's far more hassle for you than me.' 'It's out of you and your father's hands I picked my life back up... The fact you'd sit here to eat noodles means you think enough of me.' 'My dad's goal has always been for everyone to live good lives—' *thunk*— Within the rhythm of the kitchen knife and chopping board lands a heavy, muffled noise, promptly breaking off the subject. 'Sorry to scare you, Miss... The new smith here does shoddy work. There used to be a smith next door, went by 'Cleavers Leong.' The knives he sharpened cut fast and shone light. Lovely to use.' 'What happened to him?' 'Died. Five years ago, he did.' 'Five years. And people still think about him. He must've been a good man.' 'Not all that good... You could count on him, but he never held back. Never changed his mind. He made one mistake, that's all it took.' 'A very serious mistake to make.' 'You and the Rat King both see right through us. You're smart. Us people below, we're dumb. Sometimes, unwise. You'll be needing to teach us a long time more, Miss.' 'You'd listen to me, still?' 'I thank you that you didn't ask how he died, Miss.' 'You still blame me.' 'I've said it already. My life comes from out of your hands. No sense in the blame game.' '......' 'Your noodles are done, Miss.' The vendor carefully carries the bowl over to the customer, and doesn't move away after setting it down—he stands and watches her devour the noodles clean, mouthful by mouthful. After she's done, she pulls the cash out from her bag and places it on the counter. 'No need for change.' 'The streets are tricky at night. Take your time, Miss.' 'No need to worry, I can see clearly.' 'No, you'd better be careful. Us little folk, we need you. We need someone to follow.' 'It's late. Go on home.' 'Miss... 'I don't have the guts to blame you, but I just want to ask one thing... 'If, right now, you were back then, would you still do the same thing?' 'I would. 'I'm here now so that Lungmen never goes through anything like that again.'
description.zh:
已是凌晨，路灯渐渐熄了。只剩街边一角大排档店面前悬着一盏吊灯，灯光摇摇晃晃，灯下水汽蒸腾。摊主在锅边坐着，一张脸就藏在水汽后面。他远远看见来了客人，站起来欠了欠身子。
“小姐好久没来了。”
“总算得空。”
“您是大忙人，每天都见您从这边路过，您从来没在这坐过一会。”
“一碗车仔面，油面，咖喱底，加两个鳞丸。”
“晓得。”
女客人挑了个离灶台近的位置款款坐下。摊主转过身，腰躬得像条摔在地上的鳞。他舀汤下面，把卤味切块，动作行云流水。
“这么晚还没收摊，生意不错。”
“都是托鼠王的福……过去是托鼠王的福，现在是托小姐的福。我当学徒的时候，这个点没人敢开着铺面。”
“药都还够用？”
“有渠道能买到，没敢断过。要是不小心发病，给小姐惹麻烦。”
“还是要为自己保重，万一病重了，最麻烦的可不是我。”
“我这条命都是从您父女手上捡回来的……小姐还肯坐这吃碗面，是瞧得起我。”
“爸一直图的都是大伙能好活——”
哐——
菜刀和案板规律的碰撞声中突入一声沉重的闷响，生生截断话头。
“惊到小姐了……新来的铁匠手艺不好，以前隔壁有个铁匠，叫‘菜刀梁’，他磨的刀又快又亮，好使。”
“老梁人呢？”
“死了，五年前死的。”
“五年了，还常被人惦记着，应该是个好人。”
“也不算太好……人是仗义，但是性子直，又硬颈，就做了那么一件错事。”
“那是很严重的错事。”
“小姐和鼠王都是聪明人，看得透。下面人有时候笨了些，唔识事。以后还要小姐多管教。”
“你们还愿意听我的？”
“小姐刚刚没问他是怎么死的，我谢谢小姐。”
“你还是怨我。”
“我说了，这条命是从您父女手上捡回来的，我唔好怨。”
“……”
“小姐，面好了。”
摊主小心将面碗端到客人桌前，也不离开，他就站在旁边，盯着眼前的客人一口一口将面吃得干干净净。客人吃完面，从包里掏出零钱放在桌上。
“不用找。”
“夜路不好走，小姐慢走。”
“不用担心，我看得清。”
“小姐还是要小心走，我们这些人，都还得跟着您。”
“时候不早了，回家吧。”
“小姐……
“我没胆子怨您，我就是想问您一句……
“如果当年的事，换小姐现在，还做吗？”
“做。
“我现在在这，是为了龙门不会再有那个时候。”

description.en:
[Lungmen Daily Interview]
Reporter: Today we are fortunate to have a special guest—the President of the Lungmen Young Entrepreneurs' Association, Miss Lin Yühsia herself! Recently, everything seems to be smooth sailing for Miss Lin. She's had one success after the other, taking over the redevelopment of several old neighborhoods and earning the praise of our residents. Special mention goes to the amusement park—my sai lou zai's always pestering me to bring him there! Ah, I feel a headache coming on already!
Lin: It was my first time handling such a massive project, so I hope you'll all forgive me for any mistakes I might have made.
Reporter: And so humble! I must say, though, you have a good eye. Before you worked your magic, these 'laan gai' and 'hak gai' were so infamous that even big shots would make detours around our less reputable alleys... Could you share with us some of your experiences on this project?
Lin: 'Less reputable'? If any part of Lungmen is less reputable, then my colleagues and I are at fault. No one hates making money, so I need only bring everyone to one table and hammer down a price we can all be happy with.
Reporter: True enough, but they've been called 'laan gai' since our parents' generation, yet you cut out those decades-old tumors in a matter of months, Miss President. I can only imagine you have some special friends at the table?
Lin: Any connections I have are the ones I've invested in. As for the people I know, isn't it only natural to become friends with your business partners?
Reporter: And here I thought you had some ace up your sleeve—or maybe it's a trade secret you can't disclose?
Lin: Haha. I didn't realize you'd be so into gossip, sir.
Reporter: Everyone knows how gang-infested these streets are. Who knows what trouble might be just around the corner...
Lin: If I had an answer to that, I'd be the Chief of the L.G.D. by now. Though you're pretty promising yourself, to have so much information and be asking such incisive questions.
Reporter: Hahaha, you flatter me. But I must confess one small regret I have—that in just one conversation you've made it that much harder for me to consider a career change!
Lin: You're too humble. To borrow a phrase from Lungmen's fengshui masters: when prosperity blooms, bad things will naturally leave. I'd also like to use this airtime to ask everyone to support my work as the President of the LYEA.
......

'Mm, this is fine. Tell them to publish it as-is.'
'Siu ze, I did a background check and the reporter has done a number of hit pieces on you under a pseudonym.
'He says you're whitewashing the Lin family, and your new projects are crowding out other businesses from developing... Should I take care of him?'
'No need. It would be impossible to silence voices like his for good.
'Let me ask you this: If I told you Lungmen has the potential to grow its businesses for both itself and everyone else, and that is what I really want...
'Would you believe me?'
'...I would.'
'*sigh* Does it matter if you do?'
'Siu ze, I—'
'They don't need to know what I want. They just have to watch what I do.'
description.zh:
【龙门日报采访稿】
记者：今天我们有幸邀请到了青年创业协会的会长——林雨霞小姐！林小姐最近真是顺风顺水、风光无两，一连接手了好几个旧街区的改造项目，得到龙门市民的一致好评。尤其里面的游乐园，我家细路仔每天吵着要我带他去玩……唉，实在头疼啊！
林：我也是第一次经营这种大型项目，做得不够的地方，还请各位见谅。
记者：不得不说，林小姐真是非常有眼光。这些地方在你做起来之前，可都是有名的“烂街”“黑街”，再富的大佬也要绕着走……项目做得这么成功，能不能传授些经验给我们？
林：哪有什么“烂街”，如果龙门有地方发展得不好，那是我和同僚的失职。没人和赚钱过不去，我要做的，无非是把大家拉到一张桌上，敲下一个人人都满意的价格。
记者：话虽如此，可这“黑街”的名声从你我小时候就传开了。这么多年来的病灶，林会长几个月就铲除了……看来会长桌上的朋友身份不一般哈？
林：我不过是凭人脉拉拉投资。至于认识什么人——做单生意，谈笔交易，自然就成朋友咯？
记者：我以为林会长会有什么更高明的手段，还是说涉及机密不能透露？
林：哈哈，记者先生难不成也喜欢看街边的小报？
记者：人人都知道这些地方不太平，随便推个门都指不定会闯进哪个社团。
林：我要是真了解这么多，近卫局局长就该换我来当了。不过我觉得还是记者先生更有潜质，消息这么灵通，提的问题也很犀利嘛。
记者：哈哈哈会长过奖了……今天一番交流，不得不感慨，看来只要有林会长，这生意想不做都难啊！
林：客气了。按龙门的风水来讲，一个地方人气旺了，不好的东西自然就走了。这次接受采访，也是想借机宣传一下，之后还请大家多多支持我这个会长的工作。
……

“嗯，稿子没什么问题。跟他们说，就这样发吧。”
“小姐，我调查了一下，这个记者用化名在好几家报纸撰文，写了不少你的黑稿。
“他说你想洗白林家，还用这些新商业项目遏制其他企业的发展……要处理下吗？”
“不用，这种声音怎么压也压不住。
“我问你，如果我说，当下龙门能有更多的商业可能，以及为大家创造更多的机会，就是我想要的……
“你信吗？”
“……我信。”
“唉，信不信有什么关系呢？”
“小姐，我——”
“他们没必要知道我在想什么，只需要看着我在做什么就行。”
